Operation.Description: Drop the demo SQL database and remove generated demo workspaces.
Operation.Name: cleanup

Operation.Description: Author the complete MetaPipeline workspace, infer the MetaOrchestration workspace, and refresh the run plan.
Operation.Name: create-complete-run-plan

Operation.Description: Author an invalid pipeline graph, expect inference diagnostics, and inspect the emitted orchestration evidence.
Operation.Name: create-invalid-evidence

Operation.Description: Author the policy MetaPipeline workspace, infer orchestration, add explicit order and lock policy, and refresh the run plan.
Operation.Name: create-policy-run-plan

Operation.Description: Execute the prepared complete orchestration run plan. Requires META_ORCHESTRATION_DEMO_SQL in the caller environment.
Operation.Name: execute-complete

Operation.Description: Author and run the failure dependency scenario, expecting the modeled execution failure while verifying the failure branch ran.
Operation.Name: execute-failure-branch

Operation.Description: Inspect the prepared complete pipeline and orchestration workspaces.
Operation.Name: inspect-complete

Operation.Description: Create the SQL database, schema workspace, transform workspace, and binding workspace used by the orchestration demo.
Operation.Name: prepare-shared-workspaces

Operation.Description: Rebuild run-plan rows in the prepared complete orchestration workspace.
Operation.Name: refresh-complete-run-plan

Operation.Description: Validate that the caller has populated the SQL environment variables used by the demo.
Operation.Name: validate-environment
